changes.text: What's new says each change in one short line
banditshell triage files a GitHub issue after you confirm the report
banditshell doctor --report hides passwords and keys
Fresh installs start with a wallpaper, not a black screen
An empty or missing wallpaper.current shows the shipped picture
The shell starts without qt6-websockets or qt6-multimedia
Enterprise Wi-Fi such as eduroam now signs in
The lock screen no longer stalls every five minutes after a long lock
Animated icons, such as in the network menu, stop eating memory
Notification groups slide open and shut, and a click reverses mid-fold
An opened notification group gets its own gap and rounded corners
Opening the island stops where its content ends, without overshooting
The last notification has the same bottom margin as its sides
Pulling the launcher up keeps its top edge under your pointer
Dragging the open launcher down thins it and sideways makes it lean
A quick flick up or the hotkey opens the launcher at full size
The launcher search bar sits lower, set by launcher.list.searchAt
Keyring questions asked before the shell starts now show in its card
The shell adds two keyring prompter files to your dbus services folder
Password cards rise from the bottom as a frosted launcher panel
The keyring and polkit card now shows over fullscreen windows
Unlocking a keyring in the card accepts the right password every time
New keyrings no longer ask to store passwords unencrypted
Restarting the shell no longer leaves a stray keyring helper behind
Enter answers yes or no in the card, like the highlighted button
The launcher has an offline dictionary that answers as you type
Enter opens a word's meanings page, and Ctrl+Enter opens Wiktionary
Forms like geese find goose, and define lists words that start with it
After define and a space, the launcher only looks up words
Scrolling matches a web browser, and the touchpad follows your fingers
The Define words switch in Settings is now Wiktionary definitions
The shell now starts on Qt before 6.12, which Ubuntu and Debian ship
Ubuntu 26.04 and 25.10 work once Quickshell is built, per the guide
Scripts calling qs ipc keyboard float should use keyboard undock
Omarchy users keep its shell and add banditshell as a plugin
install.sh now runs on Debian, Fedora, openSUSE, Void and Alpine
A fresh install adds the OBS Qt module plus cmp, flock and time zones
The update menu always names an update by its version, not a hash
Shut down, restart and sleep work on systems without systemd
Browsing wallpapers reveals each picture instead of snapping to it
A click opens a notification and keeps it; swipe sideways to delete it
A notification with no app behind it opens big in the island on click
Opening the island shows your three newest notifications as full cards
Dragged island items follow your finger and bounce back when released
Swiping a history notification away closes the gap it leaves
Paused music stays in the island, and unplayed players stay hidden
Notifications group by app, and a swipe clears the whole app
Dictation bars step out beside the island while a view fills it
The island uses your theme's surface colour instead of near-black
Each island notification is a tile in one column, like Android
Notifications beside a swiped one are tugged along, then spring back
Notification cards take on the colour of the playing song's cover
Quick swipes no longer stack cards or leave gaps in the list
Opening the notification history no longer freezes the island briefly
control.spring in config.json sets spring stiffness, damping and mass
banditshell unstick revives a frozen shell, even over ssh
Enable the banditshell-watchdog user service to unstick a hung shell
A system update shows as a thin accent progress line on the frame top
Pacman questions and the update's end bring it back into the island
Microphone on shows briefly in the island and on the rail
Microphone on stays while something listens, and a press shows who
Camera and screen sharing read Camera on and Screen shared
The fullscreen rounded edge is back, coloured from the picture
Turn off Edge over fullscreen to draw nothing over fullscreen windows
banditshell.marcusrosado.com covers install steps and the roadmap
Update notices and the notifications row open in the island
The clock, date and temperature open timers, calendar and weather
Updating Linux runs from the island, with progress shown there
A new song pops up only when you are not looking at its window
Fullscreen windows cover the whole screen again, with no edge line
The shell removes media.waveLength and two other wave keys on start
Buttons stay round when pressed or on, and no longer cast shadows
The music seek bar is a straight line that dims when paused
Password fields in the keyring and Wi-Fi menu show dots, not clovers
The corner notification list is gone; type notifications to see them
The sidebar rests as small workspace marks until you point at it
Binds keep working; a banditshell.lua now sits beside hyprland.lua
What's new entries you have seen are kept outside config.json now
History survives restarts, and chats group into one entry with a count
Updates say what changes first and roll back if the new one fails
The island shows timers, alarms, volume, brightness and the mic in use
Type keys, tray, scratchpad, action or recent in the launcher
New commands: banditshell version, action, events and doctor --report
Settings, Launcher has Notifications in search, off by default
Movements across the shell share one curve and no longer overshoot
Settings warns when a theme, alert sound or OBS program is missing
Push an island notification up to put it away in your history
Shortcut-opened things appear at once, and Esc puts them away at once
Settings, Look, Motion sets the workspace slide, 200 ms by default
Things moving across the screen now ease in as well as out
Lock screen sleep, restart and shut down need the full hold again
The launcher sinks back into the bottom edge with its pinned apps
Once one tooltip shows, the tooltips next to it appear at once
Right-edge quick controls wait a moment before opening and closing
Nothing bounces: toggles, sliders and password dots move straight
Sidebar menus fade the new page in instead of laying it over the old
The wallpaper picker rises once, and browsing previews at once
The music card drifts back up toward the island that opened it
Reduced motion now stops fades and looping animations too
The launcher file preview no longer blinks between text files
PageUp and PageDown in the clipboard move one screen of rows
File previews leave room around the highlighted matching line
Quick controls and the power menu are centred in their panels
The narrow settings window keeps the details pane inside the panel
Music with everything closed no longer keeps the screens redrawing
Memory no longer grows with each song's cover art
Closing the launcher stops a search inside files at once
Searches inside files stop after 2 seconds and skip binary files
The launcher does less work for each key you type
The shell no longer asks for the power profile every 30 seconds
Rounded shapes are drawn by the graphics card, with smoother edges
banditshell has a GitHub front page, and it is licensed under GPL-3.0
Muted sound shows a speaker with a line through it
Where windows overlap, the screenshot picker chooses the top one
The launcher opens over a fullscreen window and leaves it fullscreen
Keys typed right after Super+Space reach the launcher, not the window
Typing or selecting a colour opens a colour picker beside the list
The launcher preview card has a clean edge and resizes smoothly
Playing music shows its cover large, and Left and Right seek 5 seconds
YouTube thumbnail previews no longer take the now playing row
A slash in a search, such as hypr/lua, finds files by their path
Files and folders matching what you type now rank above settings
Tailscale devices show status, system and address in aligned columns
Timers count down in the island, and tapping one pauses it
Monitor brightness works on monitors whose top level is not 100
Emoji picked in the launcher now arrive in Chromium and Electron apps
config.json has a new key, launcher.animatePreview, on by default
While you dictate, the island sits over the window you point at
The dictation island sinks into the top bar when you point at it
Hotkeys keep working after an update changes the banditshell command
Type bandit, or banditshell, in the launcher to run shell commands
The launcher ranks what you run higher next time, and Tab completes
More window rows work in every layout, such as swap and focus left
The launcher calculator reads dates, colours, time zones and crypto
The launcher flips night light, dark mode, airplane mode and more
The launcher moves the window you were in to halves and quarters
A card beside the launcher previews the selected row
Enter types an emoji or symbol into the app you were in
The launcher runs your own scripts from ~/.config/banditshell/scripts
Type ? and a question in the launcher for an answer from a local model
Type hello in german or define serendipity for answers from the web
Type brightness to get a slider for every screen, or brightness 40
Type ssh to connect to a host from your SSH config
Type uuid or password 20 in the launcher, and Enter copies the answer
Type layout workshop in the launcher to draw your own tiling layout
Actions that use your password only run programs from system folders
The processor temperature now reads the processor's own sensor
Uninstall finds apps whose shortcut sits in a subfolder
Snapping a window to a half, third or quarter now places it
config.json has new launcher groups, such as typing, online and ai
A fullscreen window gets the whole monitor, and the shell steps aside
Edge clicks reach a fullscreen window, and shortcuts do nothing there
The update menu stays closed when the shell starts
The list launcher shows pinned apps as large icons until you type
The launcher also finds commands, settings, files and web searches
The launcher sets timers, alarms and world clock times from typing
Launcher apps can be quit, force quit or uninstalled from their row
Any launcher row can get an alias or a hotkey from its More menu
The launcher searches for words inside files in your home folder
Admin tasks such as installs ask for the password in the keyring card
The selected launcher row shows buttons such as Pin and Copy path
Typing ~/ or / in the launcher lists that folder
Sums keep their answer as you type and convert money to your currency
The launcher calculator runs on qalc and offers to install it
Searching settings for wifi finds Wi-Fi, and dashed names match too
config.json gains launcher keys such as list.pinned and currency
The island shows several things at once, the newest in the big spot
Island notifications stack as cards, and a flick dismisses one
Clicking the music in the island turns it into the media controller
The dictation line in the island is one curve that fades at both ends
The island overview shows weather under the date, every 30 minutes
A pinned island leaves the keyboard alone and the screen clickable
The island still opens and takes clicks with the media controller open
The hotkey sheet draws a whole keyboard, with the numpad, ISO and ANSI
Dropdowns in Settings open again instead of showing an empty list
Board offers ISO, ANSI and Custom, and Custom imports VIA files
Try a sample board works again, and imported boards open for editing
Split is no longer offered under Board
The Settings list folds down to its icons with a button at its bottom
After a shell restart, your open panels and Settings page come back
The new lock screen shows a blurred wallpaper, a clock and a password
A wrong password is refused at once instead of after two seconds
The lock screen lists waiting notifications by app and the music
The password field shows your keyboard layout and a Caps Lock warning
Sleep, restart and shut down need a held press at the bottom edge
The lock screen dims after 10 seconds without a key or mouse
lock.dim now sets a veil over the wallpaper, leaving it more visible
banditshell dev try lists each worktree with its pull request status
A merged worktree you are trying sends you back to main in two minutes
In banditshell dev try, main is 0 and the running one is marked *
notch.trackWidth is gone; island settings live under island
The notch is now a floating island at the top centre of the screen
Notifications can drop from the island instead of the corner
The island tells you when a new Linux kernel is waiting to install
Finished downloads show in the island when inotify-tools is installed
banditshell panel island is the new name, and the old one still works
Scripts and keybinds must say alphabet, not the old launcher name
Settings you set on the old placeholder rows now take effect
Every setting in Settings now does what it says
Do not disturb mutes popups and sounds, and can end at a set time
Alert sounds for notifications and errors come in soft, clear or wood
Night light follows a schedule, from sunset to sunrise or set times
Display › Screens can turn a screen off or mirror another one
The sidebar shows the clock and date in several styles, or hides them
Volume past 100% is a switch
Layout, keyboard, mouse and touchpad save to your Hyprland config
Power mode, lid, low battery and idle timeouts are real settings now
Startup apps can be switched off wherever they start
Display › Screens snaps a dropped screen back to the top-left corner
A Hyprland config that fails its check is left alone, with a notice
Updates set your edits to a changed file aside in git stash
Open special workspaces show their apps' icons again
A special workspace with several apps shows each app's icon
Settings opens from the sidebar and stays open while you work
Pointing at a setting shows what it does and its config.json key
Screen changes wait for Apply, then a new mode reverts unless kept
New settings save your choice and start working in a later update
banditshell panel settings open takes a category, page or config key
Setting values and recent changes are saved in settings.json
Updates install the version the menu found, or say plainly why not
The update icon above the clock shows only when something needs doing
sidebar.update in config.json sets the icon: new, always or never
Tab completion for banditshell stays current in every terminal
Commands now start with the thing, and old binds keep working
Old banditshell volume or lock commands run wpctl or loginctl
Try, back, build, test and check moved under banditshell dev
banditshell screenshot full saves the whole desktop
The wallpaper picker sits lower and smaller, current one in the middle
The wallpaper you look at shows over your dimmed windows
Colour swatches narrow the picker, and / searches by name
Under the picker: name, resolution, shuffle, fit, screen and Set
A ring marks the wallpaper only while you move with the arrow keys
Set or Enter always applies, so Every screen works straight away
Colour groups per wallpaper are cached in wallpaper-colours.json
banditshell try takes a list number or a unique part of a branch
banditshell try runs an unmerged branch, banditshell back undoes it
Leaving streamer mode removes the band and restores screen frames
button.scale and files.text are gone, and their sizes no longer apply
All shell text uses three sizes, so a few button labels shift slightly
The dictation pill's language tag is centred beside the bars
Starting the shell leaves monitor brightness alone until you change it
Six keys are gone; use screen.linger and screen.grabFraction now
banditshell set stream on DP-1 puts a band across that screen's top
The band has an OBS deck to go live, record and switch scenes
Other screens reserve no space while streaming, so no window moves
The dictation pill tucks away when the pointer comes near
A right-edge card holds sound, brightness and warmth
Security fixes for Wi-Fi passwords, notifications and keyring prompts
The lock screen locks before sleep and survives shell reloads
The shell scans Wi-Fi only while a network list is open
Typed paths are quoted, and the terminal redraws only changed rows
Log out ends this session, not every session you have open
banditshell completions install sets up zsh and bash tab completion
config.json gains stream and clock keys by itself, with nothing to do
Source files get plain, searchable names, and the shell acts the same
The QML language server resolves imports; new files need qmldirs.sh
Source comments are cut to a bare minimum, and the shell is unchanged
Bare mode also zeroes window rounding and gaps, even after a reboot
Super+Shift+K toggles bare mode, hiding the chrome on every screen
edge.bare in config.json holds the bare mode switch, off by default
Each monitor can hide the sidebar, set on Monitors or with Super+K
sidebar.enabled is the default, sidebar.perScreen lists exceptions
